newsitem.title: USA: National Steel says to sell Iron Ore stake.
newsitem.headline: National Steel says to sell Iron Ore stake.

text.p: National Steel Corp said it plans to use proceeds from the sale of its interest in Iron Ore Co of Canada to strengthen its balance sheet and is evaluating other alternative uses for the money.

The steel company said Friday it entered into a definitive agreement to sell its 21.7-percent interest in Iron Ore to Australia's North Ltd, a forestry and mining concern, for about $85 million, which will result in an after-tax gain for the company of about $25 million.
"National will continue to purchase iron ore from IOC under the terms of long-term contracts," National said.
"National intends to utilize the net sale proceeds to further strengthen its balance sheet and is evaluating alternatives," it said.
Bethlehem Steel Corp will also sell its minority interest in Iron Ore to North, National said.

The National-North transaction is subject to approval by the other shareholders of Iron Ore Co and customary governmental approvals. Closing is expected to occur late in the first quarter of 1997, National said.
